decisions.evidence_boundary: every result in this lane is fixture evidence: an in-process fake gh / mocks / isolated subprocess that is refused before any gh. No real GitHub write and no network. Nothing here is live GitHub evidence.

decisions.repository_identity: TRUSTED_REPO = load_trusted_repo_slug() (config/repository_identity.v1.json) evaluated at import; the policy already does the same. An unusable config or layout shift raises RepositoryIdentityError at import (10 negative cases under python -I). main() additionally refuses a non-str TRUSTED_REPO and any --repo that is not exactly equal, before any subprocess (spy: 0 calls, not even git).
decisions.approval_gate: APPROVED_LIVE_COMMAND_IDS = {issue_body.update, issue_content.update, issue_comment.publish}. The gate sits right after the unknown-command check in main() (the existing dispatch boundary): refused ids never reach the repo/git/gh checks or any handler (handlers spied in test).
